(1) 过点 $O$ 作 $OH \perp DC$，垂足为 $H$
$\because AD \parallel BC$，$\angle ADC = 90^\circ$，$OH \perp DC$，$\therefore \angle BCD = \angle OHC = \angle ADC = 90^\circ$，$\therefore AD \parallel OH \parallel BC$
又 $\because OA = OB$，$\therefore DH = HC$
$\because OH \perp DC$，$OH$ 过圆心，$\therefore EH = HF$
$\therefore DH - EH = HC - HF$，即 $DE = CF$
(2) 过点 $A$ 作 $AG \perp BC$，垂足为点 $G$，$\angle AGB = 90^\circ$；$\because \angle AGB = \angle BCD = 90^\circ$，$\therefore AG \parallel DC$
$\because AD \parallel BC$，$\therefore AD = CG$；$\because AD = 2$，$BC = 4$，$\therefore BG = BC - CG = 2$
在 Rt$\triangle AGB$ 中，$\because \tan B = 3$，$\therefore AG = BG \cdot \tan B = 2 \times 3 = 6$
在 Rt$\triangle AGB$ 中，$AB^2 = AG^2 + BG^2$，$\therefore AB = 2\sqrt{10}$
stem: 如图，梯形 $ABCD$ 中，$AD\parallel BC$，$\angle ADC = 90^\circ$，$AD = 2$，$BC = 4$，$\tan B = 3$。以 $AB$ 为直径作 $\odot O$，交边 $DC$ 于 $E$、$F$ 两点。(1) 求证：$DE = CF$；(2) 求直径 $AB$ 的长。
